game.q: still sick, all ten set off for the priests. what happens on the road?
opts: they give up and turn around

wrong.wait: no waiting-room scene. it happens on the way.
wrong.quit: one does turn around. but not to quit.

game.right: YES. healed on the way. they trusted his word before anything changed.

end.line: ten were healed on the road. one turned back to say thank you, loudly, in the dust.

cliff.s1: next week opens with an old rule.
cliff.s2: it keeps turning up in surprising places.
cliff.tmr: tomorrow: the rule that keeps turning up.

share: ten got healed. one said thanks. the one who came back, on infinite hill
